analysis_population: 600 frozen V1 model-task-horizon rows and 4,800 metric comparisons: 13 models, eight S/MS tasks, six horizons, four path and four terminal metrics; VAR-difference covers only 24 multivariate cells. Computational profiles use 2,160 learned-model task-horizon-seed runs: 240 per model
exports: PDF at native physical dimensions and RGB PNG with at least 300 dpi metadata

metrics.MAE: path mean absolute error in original target units
metrics.MSE: path mean squared error in squared target units
metrics.RMSE: path root mean squared error in original target units
metrics.RMSSE: path RMSE divided by the task's training naive-difference scale
metrics.Terminal MAE: absolute error at the final forecast endpoint
metrics.Terminal MSE: squared error at the final forecast endpoint
metrics.Terminal RMSE: root squared error at the final forecast endpoint
metrics.Terminal RMSSE: terminal RMSE divided by the task's training naive-difference scale

missing_data: none in primary metrics; VAR-difference is structurally unavailable for S tasks
profile_scope: runtime starts before experiment construction and ends after training and final evaluation; peak memory is torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated after resetting CUDA peak statistics. Configurations are independently validation-selected, and these are not matched-size inference-latency, throughput, FLOP, energy, or kernel-level measurements
status: provisional general scientific figures; target journal not specified
transformations: within-cell rank uses lower-is-better metric values with minimum rank for ties
gap percent is 100 * (model metric / cell winner metric - 1)
task-balanced metrics average short-, middle-, and long-term means with equal term weight
head-to-head percent is 100 * (PMS metric / comparator metric - 1)
term head-to-head summaries use path RMSE and preserve the frozen short, middle, and long horizon groups
dataset shifts express validation or test target means in training target SD units
dataset volatility shifts divide validation or test first-difference SD by training first-difference SD
all-model horizon figures use equally spaced frozen horizon categories and logarithmic y-axes for positive error metrics
task-model RMSSE heatmap clips color at 60% but prints the rounded unclipped value in each cell
profile summaries report observed runtime and CUDA maximum allocated memory without workload normalization
profile IQR is the 25th to 75th percentile across completed runs
model summaries pool 240 runs; horizon summaries pool 40 runs per model-horizon; task summaries pool 30 runs per model-task
profile figures use logarithmic axes or color normalization and print untransformed runtime or memory values
uncertainty: accuracy figures report descriptive five-seed means from the frozen aggregate table; profile figures report empirical run distributions without confidence intervals; confirmatory bootstrap contrasts remain in the V1 release
